author: Edmunds & Just, 1983

note.en: A small aeolid nudibranch of about 1 cm known here from three specimens taken at Puerto Vargas point and off Manzanillo between 1 and 6 m depth.
note.es: Un pequeño nudibranquio eólido de cerca de 1 cm conocido aquí por tres ejemplares tomados en la punta de Puerto Vargas y frente a Manzanillo, entre 1 y 6 m de profundidad.

evidence: GBIF: 3 preserved specimens in the region (INBio Atta collection, 2000 and 2002)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection), Gandoca to Limón
